svg.title: Figure 1. Job Alerts: postings from SimplifyJobs, Greenhouse, Lever, RemoteOK and Adzuna pass rule filters for experience, sponsorship and degree, then LLM fit ranking with the Claude API, drafted answers with a learning memory profile, and human review. Playwright pre-fills forms but never submits.

g.text: 10,000+ postings in, a short list out

svg.text: every correction feeds the memory profile
